title: Orbit spec check result (orbit.spec-check/1)
description: What `orbit spec check <file | issue> --json` prints: whether a Markdown body is a spec `orbit run --issue` takes (docs/decisions/0019-run-from-issue.md), with every problem and what was read. Exactly one of `file` and `issue` names what was checked. Removing or retyping a field is a new version (orbit.spec-check/2) and a new schema.

ok.description: True when there is no problem.

file.description: The file as named on the command line.

updated_at.description: When the issue was last updated, as GitHub reports it.

problems.description: One line per problem, empty when ok.

scenarios.description: The keys of the acceptance scenarios (S<story>-<n>), in order.

implementation_notes.description: Whether the body has an implementation notes section (outside the spec).
